messages:
Mira Chen: Rooftop movie + ice cream run tomorrow evening? Projector works, bring a blanket if you want. :icecream: :movie_camera:
Alex: hell yes. what movie? :popcorn:
Jamal: i can bring speakers and a cooler. what time were you thinking?
Priya: might be late (birthday dinner), but i can swing by for dessert around 9pm. where's the creamerie?
Mira Chen: new spot on 4th — Samor said they open late. planning to set up at 7:30 so we can catch sunset + movie (~8:15).
Samor: yep 4th Creamery open til 10. i'll grab a folding table and two lanterns.
Alex: i'll handle cables/extension cord. tagging ops for power check: @room-bot
room-bot: Quick check — rooftop 3 has power outlet on the west rail, no reservations needed after 6pm. Enjoy!
Jamal: score. bringing mint chip. quick poll: react with :icecream: if you'll bring dessert; :popcorn: if you'll bring savory snacks; :beer: if you want drinks.
Mira Chen: quick checklist:
```
- projector (ok)
- speakers (Jamal)
- table (Samor)
- extension (Alex)
- blankets (voluntary)
```
Priya: i can bring two blankets. also low-key open to a short playlist swap beforehand — drop your fav 2 songs here.
Alex: adding: 'Electric Feel' and 'Fade Into You'
Mira Chen: love it. safe to say plan is 7:30 setup, 8:15 movie. RSVP by reacting. :thumbsup:
Jamal: :thumbsup:
Samor: :thumbsup:
Alex: :thumbsup:
Helm: would join but camping out of town, have fun! :camping:
